fullContentHtml:
India Post Office GDS 1st Merit List 2026 – Out – Full Details

Department of Post (India Post) has released the 1st merit list for the post of Gramin Dak Sevaks GDS on the official website of India Post. This recruitment was released for 23757 posts. The applications for India Post Office GDS Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 31 August 2026 to 21 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their India Post GDS 1st Merit List 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Registration Starting Date : 31 August 2026
  • Registration Last Date : 19 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Form Submission Last Date : 21 September 2026
  • Pee Payment Last Date : 21 September 2026
  • Correction Date : 23-24 September 2026
  • 1st Merit List : 12 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Important Links

  • Download 1st Merit List
  • Online Registration
  • Apply Online
  • Download Circle Wise Vacancy Details
  • Download Notification

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is India Post Office GDS 1st Merit List 2026 – Out?

India Post Office GDS 1st Merit List 2026 – Out is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
